name: o44052

datetime.description: the date and time in ISO 8601 UTC when this message was sent. if 'status' is either 'ingested' or 'published', then this is the date and time recorded in lax

id.description: the article identifier, potentially without leading zeroes. if original request could not be parsed, a null value will be returned

message.description: elaborates on the status. if invalid, what is invalid. if in error, what failed.

token.description: data from original request to be returned to the sender once action complete. if original request could not be parsed, a null value will be returned

description:
Subject: Publication Confirmation – Article 12345678  

Dear Contributor,  

We are pleased to inform you that the requested action **publish** for article 12345678 has been completed successfully. The system recorded this event at **2026-06-15T12:34:56Z**, and the status is now **published**. The accompanying message reads: “Article successfully published.” For your reference, the token you supplied with the original request was **abc123def456**.  

If you have any further questions or need additional assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. Thank you for using our publishing platform.
